stories.headline: New Hampshire market discussion brings several perspectives together
stories.body: UNH Extension’s Forest Products Markets Update is scheduled for October 22, from 5 to 6:30 p.m., online through Zoom. Registration is required. The current listing offers 1.5 Society of American Foresters continuing forestry education credits.
